title: SQL Practice Virtual Lab
desc: Full-scale interactive SQL learning platform featuring 5 topic-wise modules (DDL/DML, Aggregations, Multi-table JOINs, Subqueries, and Window Functions / CTEs). Features real-time parallel output comparison, dynamic schema inspection with sample data previews, and persistent scoring via @juetguna.in student authentication.

title: Enterprise Relational Schema Simulator
desc: Interactive multi-entity database modeling environment representing real-world healthcare and corporate relational topologies. Enables students to observe primary and foreign key constraints, entity integrity, and cascading operations in an isolated sandbox.

title: Automated Code Evaluation & Grading Engine
desc: Server-side automated grading microservice that securely executes student SQL queries in sandboxed in-memory database instances, computes cell-level diff comparisons against reference benchmarks, and logs student performance metrics into SQLite.

title: DBMS Query Execution Plan & Cost Visualizer
desc: Developing an interactive D3.js physical query plan visualizer that decomposes user queries into Relational Algebra AST trees, illustrating table scans, index lookups, hash joins, and cost-based optimization formulas in real-time.

title: AI SQL Error Diagnostic & Remediation Tutor
desc: An intelligent automated pedagogical tutor that interprets cryptic SQL syntax and runtime error codes, generating step-by-step guidance and conceptual hints tailored to undergraduate students without giving away direct solutions.

title: ACID Concurrency & 2-Phase Locking Simulator
desc: An interactive transaction scheduling sandbox simulating concurrent read/write locks, deadlocks, dirty reads, and 2-Phase Locking (2PL) protocols under varying isolation levels.
